checkpoint_review: The Router was overly strict on the 'smooth rind' checkpoint. While the taxonomy mentions 'smooth', it also explicitly lists 'small raised bumps or spines'. The image shows a pickling/gherkin-type cucumber which is naturally bumpy. This is a valid subclass variation, not a failure of class alignment. Therefore, I disagree with marking 'is_present: false' for the smoothness checkpoint in the context of penalizing alignment; it should be viewed as a neutral feature of this specific variety. The Router correctly marked the seed cavity checkpoints as untestable due to occlusion/lack of cross-section.

I will downgrade the artifact severity slightly but keep the observation of ambiguity.

All testable structural checkpoints (shape, elongation, flesh color) are present. The image is a high-quality representation of the class.
